steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: assert-drawings-hidden-in-simple
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().featureFlags.drawings !== false) throw new Error('drawings flag should be OFF in Simple mode but got: ' + window.__store.getState().featureFlags.drawings)

steps.name: assert-elevations-panel-closed-in-simple
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().elevationsOpen) throw new Error('elevationsOpen should be false in Simple mode')

steps.name: assert-drawings-enabled-in-pro
steps.eval: if (!window.__store.getState().featureFlags.drawings) throw new Error('drawings flag should be ON in Pro mode but got: ' + window.__store.getState().featureFlags.drawings)

steps.name: assert-lux-overlay-on
steps.eval: if (!window.__store.getState().luxOverlayOn) throw new Error('luxOverlayOn should be true after toggle')

steps.name: assert-overlay-reflects-new-hour
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().manualHour !== 19) throw new Error('manualHour should be 19 after scrub, got: ' + window.__store.getState().manualHour); if (!window.__store.getState().luxOverlayOn) throw new Error('luxOverlayOn should still be on')

steps.name: assert-lux-off
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().luxOverlayOn) throw new Error('luxOverlayOn should be false after disable')

steps.name: assert-drawings-hidden-again
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().featureFlags.drawings !== false) throw new Error('drawings should be OFF again in Simple mode')
